proposed_widenings.name: FeatRecord / feat kind
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no 'feat' kind. types.ts defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. feat_root exists in the v4 atom taxonomy but has no corresponding surface record type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Defense — Fighting Style Feat (Prerequisite: Fighting Style Feature)

proposed_widenings.name: passive_ac_modifier effect or FeatMechanics family
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic is a passive, always-on +1 AC conditional on wearing armor (Light/Medium/Heavy). No existing ClassFeatureEffect variant covers a passive numeric AC bonus. modify_ac exists only as a ReactionEffect (Shield-shaped). A feat-level passive AC modifier needs either a new ClassFeatureEffect variant or a new FeatMechanics family with a passive-modifier shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: you gain a +1 bonus to Armor Class

proposed_widenings.name: armor_type_filter / equipment_condition predicate
proposed_widenings.justification: The bonus is gated on wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor. There is no existing surface type for an equipment-state predicate (worn armor category). This is a precondition filter on a passive effect, distinct from any existing Attachment or ReactionTrigger shape.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While you're wearing Light, Medium, or Heavy armor

notes: Three distinct gaps: (1) no FeatRecord kind in UnitRecord; (2) no passive AC-modifier ClassFeatureEffect variant — modify_ac exists only as a ReactionEffect; (3) no equipment-state predicate (worn armor type) usable as a passive precondition. All three would need to land together for Defense to encode cleanly.
